tldr.en: Written the morning after xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin announced his departure, this essay reads his farewell note on X as a textbook example of leaving a company without demoralizing the team. He frames the exit as a continuation of the mission, credits the team through vivid shared memories, tells a story rather than issuing a statement, and ends on optimism. Writing as an immigrant and entrepreneur himself, the author draws further lessons from an immigrant's lens: carrying values from one's roots, pivoting when paths are blocked, turning hardship into ambition, keeping a sense of urgency, and paying it forward. The essay ends with a personal framework. Perceive and appreciate beauty in others, distill what you learn, and use AI as a thinking and writing partner to share it. All of it begins with a curious eye and a heart in touch.
tldr.hans: xAI 联合创始人伊戈尔·巴布什金（Igor Babuschkin）宣布离职的第二天早上，作者读了他在 X 上的告别信，视之为离开自己参与创立的公司、却不挫伤团队士气的经典范例：把离开定位为使命的延续，借生动的共同记忆把功劳归于团队，讲一个故事而不只是发表声明，并以情感与乐观作结。作为一名移民和创业者，作者又从移民的视角读出更多启示：传承核心价值、在传统路径受阻时转向、让困境化为雄心、保持紧迫感、回馈社会。文章最后分享了一个人生框架：感知并欣赏他人与世界的美好，提炼自己的收获，再以 AI 为思考与写作的伙伴把它分享出去；而这一切的起点，是一双好奇的眼睛和一颗感通的心。
